content.title: ABB 261-2863 Three Phase Electric Motor, TEFC, IE3, 21.5A Full Load Current
content.short_description: ABB 261-2863 is a three phase TEFC electric motor rated IE3 premium efficiency with a full load current of 21.5 A.
content.long_description:
The ABB 261-2863 is a three phase electric motor built with a totally enclosed fan-cooled (TEFC) enclosure for use in environments where dust and moisture ingress must be limited without requiring explosion-proof construction. The enclosure design cools the motor via an external fan while keeping internal components sealed from the surrounding atmosphere.

This motor operates at a full load current of 21.5 A and carries an IE3 (Premium) efficiency classification, indicating conformance to the IE3 tier of the international efficiency standard for three phase induction motors. Selection of this unit should account for the 21.5 A full load current rating when sizing branch circuit protection, overload relays, and conductor gauge per applicable electrical code.

The ABB 261-2863 is suited for industrial power and motion applications where three phase supply is available and IE3 efficiency is specified or required by facility energy standards. Confirm voltage, frequency, and mounting configuration against the full nameplate data before installation.
